text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I happen to spot Eishin Flash while browsing through the stores in the basement floor of a department store.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I have nearly all the ingredients I need. All that's left is to get some fruits…

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Oh, hello, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: A friend of mine wishes to make Valentine's Day chocolates, so I thought it would be nice to prepare different desserts for her reference.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: In addition to normal chocolate, I plan to make cupcakes and some other sweets.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: If you're interested in the process, you're welcome to observe me as I work.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I will begin baking in… an hour and thirty-three seconds from now.
choice_data_list: I'd love to come and watch!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: In that case, could you help me finish up my shopping? I have twenty more minutes to get the things I need.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After helping her track down everything on her list, the two of us go to the kitchen in the cafeteria.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: There. Preparations are finally complete. I set some time aside for a break before starting, so let's have some tea first.
choice_data_list: You look great in those clothes.
You look great in those clothes.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Do you think so? Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I'm honored to receive such praise. It makes all the agonizing I did over the design worth it.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: It's all thanks to the craftspeople who put it together. Their skill is what truly makes my outfit come to life.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I chose the base design from a catalog and asked them to create an outfit with a patissier motif.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I received several design concepts, but they were all so incredible that I had trouble selecting one.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: But then, while debating my choices, I suddenly recalled the sight of my father making pastries.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: That's when this design came to me and somehow I knew… this is what I needed.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Naturally, this is not what my father wears, but the design does remind me of him.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: For example, my father's eyes are passionate and focused. Those qualities are the pride of a patissier.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I am not yet a professional in that line of work, but even so, I would like to wear something with the same pride and dignity my father has.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: It's important to pour one's heart and soul into every aspect of the baking process, no matter how insignificant it may seem.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I don't believe pastries make people happy simply because of their taste, but because of the love that goes into making them.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Every smile we help create as patissiers is absolutely priceless.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I must keep that in mind when I wear these clothes… wherever I may be.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Even though she's only making samples for her friend, I can tell Eishin Flash is putting her all into making each one.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I think about how happy her pastries must make people feel. How could anyone be unhappy after eating something she made?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But when I tell her as much…

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Glück… Happiness, you say?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: In that case, I wonder if you will become happy too.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I will begin baking in two minutes.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: When the pastries are done… would you like to taste them?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, I eagerly watch as Eishin Flash deftly whips up an assortment of desserts.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Before long, all sorts of pastries line the table, infusing the space with their sweet smell. They look so good, I let out a small, excited squeal without thinking.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: …Hehe. That is exactly the smile I had hoped to see.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Eishin Flash touches her outfit with a gentle smile.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: …I hope that is truly the case.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I intend to make these sample desserts to the best of my ability…

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: However, I would also like to see what kinds of chocolates are on display in the shops.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: With Valentine's Day approaching, well-known shops from other prefectures should have shops in the larger department stores soon.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: When they do… would you like to come with me to see their displays?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Eishin Flash looks so happy as she bakes, but there's also a dignified air about her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I have a feeling I'm seeing her in the same way she saw her father in all his gallant glory.
